'''Reeker Fangs''' are a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] used as a [[:Category:Drops#Materials|Material]] to craft [[Infectious Blade Fragment|Infectious Blade Fragments]], a [[:Category:Weapons' Components|Weapons' Component]].

== ''Obtainment'' ==
*Dropped by the [[Primitive Reeker]] and [[Adapted Reeker]].
*Can be found in [[Malignant Growth|Malignant Growths]].
